 EuroTier and EnergyDecentral return to Hanover in 2026
 

 Trade fairs to run 10–13 November with focus on livestock systems

 

 
 
 
 
 28 April 2026
 
 

 
 
 
 4 minute read
 
 

 
 
 
 By: Global Ag Media 
 

 

 
 
 
 
 Europe

 

 

 

 

 EuroTier 2026, a major international trade fair for livestock production, will take place alongside EnergyDecentral from 10 to 13 November 2026 in Hanover, Germany. The ticket shop is now open.

The combined events will cover around 220,000 square metres and are expected to host more than 2,100 exhibitors and organisations from over 50 countries. Exhibitors will present technologies and systems for livestock farming, with a focus on efficiency, sustainability and animal welfare across dairy and beef cattle, pigs, poultry, sheep, goats and horses.

The programme also includes the Inhouse Farming – Feed & Food Show, which highlights developments in areas such as aquaculture and alternative proteins.

Organisers say the 2026 edition will include several new formats, including the EuroTier Milky Way, where dairy-related technologies will be presented across multiple halls. Other additions include DLG-VetCon, a new networking and training event for veterinarians working with large animals, and the Innovation Boulevard, showcasing selected entries from the EuroTier and EnergyDecentral innovation awards.

Ticket sales for EuroTier 2026 are now open. One-day tickets cost €33 online or €42 at the gate. A four-day pass is priced at €78 online or €99 on site. Tickets are valid for entry from 10 to 13 November.

DLG Spotlights – live demonstrations and special exhibits

Under the guiding theme “Intelligence in animal farming”, exhibitors will demonstrate how innovative approaches and strategies can further improve efficiency, sustainability and animal welfare, both at their stands and within the DLG Spotlights:

 Spotlight TopTierTreff (Hall 11):

The central meeting place for national and international breeders. Leading breeding companies and organizations present current breeding strategies with a space dedicated to dialogue, knowledge transfer and innovation in dairy and beef cattle breeding. Animals will remain at the exhibitors’ stands and be shown via video on a panoramic screen instead of being led onto a stage as previously.Spotlight Forage Production (Hall 12):As part of a curated special exhibition, exhibitors show what smart farming means in forage production and how feed quality can be positively influenced from cutting through to silage. The program is complemented by the new Forage Days on 12 and 13 November. As part of the DLG Spotlight “Forage Production”, the DLG Expert Stage Cattle will focus specifically on needs‑based ruminant feeding.

 Spotlight Barn Robot Event (Hall 13):This year, registered milking technology manufacturers will present the latest robotic solutions for automated milking. The focus will be on conversion solutions from conventional parlors to robots, new building concepts and milking in large herds. 

Spotlight Emission Reduction in Pig and Poultry Farming (Hall 17):

How can animal husbandry and environmental protection be reconciled? Participating exhibitors will showcase innovative processes and technologies for reducing emissions from pig and poultry farming. Experts will present solutions that relieve environmental pressure, promote animal health and maintain farm profitability.

Spotlight Innovation Boulevard (Hall 21):

For the first time, exhibitors will have the opportunity to present innovations in the EuroTier and EnergyDecentral Award scheme to visitors in a central location.

Spotlight “DLG Solar Initiative + On‑farm Energy” (EnergyDecentral, Hall 25):

This spotlight demonstrates how agricultural businesses can become key pillars of regional energy supply through agrivoltaics, battery storage and biogas. The focus is on integration into existing infrastructure and identifying new business opportunities and greater energy self‑sufficiency.Spotlight Inhouse Farming: Circular Economy (Hall 24):

A central theme is the production of alternative proteins with a focus on agricultural circularity. Through selected exhibits and targeted information, the spotlight offers compact, in‑depth insights into technologies and concepts for new protein production systems.Expert Stages – topic‑focused hubsEuroTier 2026 will once again feature several Expert Stages:

DLG Expert Stage Cattle (Hall 12) – breeding, feeding strategies, animal health, climate protection, sustainability, market and marketing perspectives

DLG Expert Stage Pig (Hall 17) – linking animal welfare, feeding and emission reduction with profitability and social acceptance

DLG Expert Stage Poultry (Hall 17) – production systems, animal welfare, hygiene, nutrition, emissions and market developments

DLG Expert Stage Barn Robot Event (Hall 13) – presentations and technical contributions complementing the Barn Robot Event

DLG Expert Stage “Intelligence in animal farming” (DLG stand, Hall 13) – ideas that make intelligent farming a reality

DLG Studio Stage (DLG stand, Hall 13) – compact, interactive formats on key agricultural topics and personal development

DLG Expert Stage EnergyDecentral (Hall 25) – daily discussions on biogas, photovoltaics, energy storage, wood energy, combined heat and power and carbon farming

DLG Expert Stage Inhouse Farming (Hall 24) – the future of alternative proteins, indoor production and sustainable agri‑systems

DLG Expert Stage Biosecurity / Feed Safety (Hall 21) – hygiene concepts, feed quality and new management and prevention technologies.

Networking & events

EuroTier serves as a platform for flagship events in the international livestock sector, bringing farmers, agri‑business representatives and experts together for networking and professional exchange. In cooperation with partner organizations, numerous conferences and evening events are planned, including the International Cattle & Pig Event, the International Poultry Conference, the International Poultry Event, DLG‑VetCon 2026, the Young Professionals Day and the International Farmers Day.

The program is complemented by the Science Campus, agri‑food start‑ups and the Female Agri Fellows Networking Event.

Award‑winning innovations – inspiring people

As the world’s leading trade fair for livestock professionals, EuroTier is the international platform for pioneering innovations and concepts. The DLG presents leading international awards:

Two awards: Innovation Award EuroTier and EnergyDecentrail  – recognizing practical livestock technology and renewable energy innovations

Animal Welfare Award – honouring products and services that significantly improve animal welfare and health

Women in Ag Award – recognizing inspiring women from agriculture, agribusiness, education, research and development

DLG Agri Influencer Award – awarded to outstanding YouTubers, TikTokers and Facebook and Instagram creators

translationZh:
EuroTier 2026，这一国际领先的畜牧生产贸易展会，将与EnergyDecentral于2026年11月10日至13日在德国汉诺威同期举办。门票现已开售。

联合展会将覆盖约22万平方米，预计吸引来自50多个国家的2100多家参展商和组织。参展商将展示畜牧养殖的技术与系统，重点关注奶牛、肉牛、猪、家禽、绵羊、山羊和马在效率、可持续性和动物福利方面的提升。

展会项目还包括Inhouse Farming – Feed & Food Show，重点展示水产养殖和替代蛋白等领域的发展。

主办方表示，2026年展会将推出多个新形式，包括EuroTier Milky Way，届时奶牛相关技术将在多个展馆展出。其他新增项目包括DLG-VetCon，这是一个面向大型动物兽医的新的社交和培训活动，以及Innovation Boulevard，展示EuroTier和EnergyDecentral创新奖的精选入围作品。

EuroTier 2026门票现已开售。单日票线上33欧元，现场42欧元。四日通票线上78欧元，现场99欧元。门票适用于11月10日至13日入场。

**DLG Spotlights – 现场演示与特别展览**

在“畜牧业的智能”这一主题下，参展商将展示创新方法和策略如何进一步提高效率、可持续性和动物福利，无论是在其展位还是在DLG Spotlights中：

**Spotlight TopTierTreff（11号馆）：**

国内外育种者的中心聚会场所。领先的育种公司和组织将展示当前的育种策略，并设有专门的空间用于奶牛和肉牛育种方面的对话、知识转移和创新。动物将留在参展商展位，通过全景屏幕以视频形式展示，而非像以前那样被带到舞台上。

**Spotlight Forage Production（12号馆）：**

作为策划的特别展览的一部分，参展商将展示智能农业在饲料生产中的意义，以及如何从收割到青贮过程中积极影响饲料质量。该计划由11月12日至13日的新Forage Days补充。作为DLG Spotlight“饲料生产”的一部分，DLG Expert Stage Cattle将特别关注基于需求的反刍动物饲喂。

**Spotlight Barn Robot Event（13号馆）：**

今年，注册的挤奶技术制造商将展示自动挤奶的最新机器人解决方案。重点将放在从传统挤奶厅到机器人的转换解决方案、新建筑概念和大群挤奶。

**Spotlight Emission Reduction in Pig and Poultry Farming（17号馆）：**

如何协调畜牧生产与环境保护？参展商将展示减少猪和家禽养殖排放的创新工艺和技术。专家将介绍减轻环境压力、促进动物健康并保持农场盈利能力的解决方案。

**Spotlight Innovation Boulevard（21号馆）：**

参展商首次有机会在中心位置向参观者展示EuroTier和EnergyDecentral奖计划中的创新。

**Spotlight “DLG Solar Initiative + On-farm Energy”（EnergyDecentral，25号馆）：**

该Spotlight展示了农业企业如何通过农光互补、电池存储和沼气成为区域能源供应的关键支柱。重点是整合到现有基础设施中，并识别新的商业机会和更高的能源自给自足。

**Spotlight Inhouse Farming: Circular Economy（24号馆）：**

核心主题是替代蛋白的生产，重点是农业循环。通过精选展品和有针对性的信息，该Spotlight提供了对新蛋白生产系统技术和概念的紧凑、深入洞察。

**Expert Stages – 主题聚焦中心**

EuroTier 2026将再次设多个Expert Stages：

**DLG Expert Stage Cattle（12号馆）** – 育种、饲喂策略、动物健康、气候保护、可持续性、市场和营销视角

**DLG Expert Stage Pig（17号馆）** – 将动物福利、饲喂和减排与盈利能力和社会的接受度联系起来

**DLG Expert Stage Poultry（17号馆）** – 生产系统、动物福利、卫生、营养、排放和市场发展

**DLG Expert Stage Barn Robot Event（13号馆）** – 与Barn Robot Event相辅相成的演示和技术贡献

**DLG Expert Stage “Intelligence in animal farming”（DLG展位，13号馆）** – 使智能农业成为现实的想法

**DLG Studio Stage（DLG展位，13号馆）** – 关于关键农业主题和个人发展的紧凑、互动形式

**DLG Expert Stage EnergyDecentral（25号馆）** – 每日讨论沼气、光伏、储能、木材能源、热电联产和碳农业

**DLG Expert Stage Inhouse Farming（24号馆）** – 替代蛋白、室内生产和可持续农业系统的未来

**DLG Expert Stage Biosecurity / Feed Safety（21号馆）** – 卫生概念、饲料质量以及新的管理和预防技术。

**社交与活动**

EuroTier是国际畜牧领域旗舰活动的平台，将农民、农业企业代表和专家聚集在一起，进行社交和专业交流。与合作伙伴组织合作，计划举办众多会议和晚间活动，包括International Cattle & Pig Event、International Poultry Conference、International Poultry Event、DLG-VetCon 2026、Young Professionals Day和International Farmers Day。

该计划还包括Science Campus、农业食品初创企业和Female Agri Fellows Networking Event。

**获奖创新 – 激励人心**

作为世界领先的畜牧专业人士贸易展会，EuroTier是开创性创新和概念的国际平台。DLG颁发以下国际奖项：

两项大奖：EuroTier和EnergyDecentral创新奖 – 表彰实用的畜牧技术和可再生能源创新

动物福利奖 – 表彰显著改善动物福利和健康的产品和服务

农业女性奖 – 表彰来自农业、农业企业、教育、研究和开发领域的鼓舞人心的女性

DLG农业影响者奖 – 授予杰出的YouTuber、TikToker以及Facebook和Instagram创作者
